text: Entry Requirements 1. College students above 18 years of age . 2. And the general state of the applicant's health should be good enough for him/her to pursue the course of study at Fudan. 3. Proof of English proficiency: TOEFL iBT (a score of 85 or above)/IELTS (a score of 6.5 or above), or other materials proving a corresponding level of English. Native English-speakers or college students taking an English-taught program are exempted from this requirement.
